# S11 — Brand theme: light and dark palettes following the system

**Findings:** ConsecutorTheme.kt (template #6200EE light-only); res/values/themes.xml DarkActionBar · **Size:** S · **Tree:** ui

**Not in this slice:** Material You dynamic color and an in-app theme override. Both are owner decisions: no dynamic color, follow the system.

## Why

- `ConsecutorTheme` hardcodes the Android-template light scheme, so dark mode renders black text on white.
- The XML theme is `Theme.MaterialComponents.DayNight.DarkActionBar` with the template purple and teal colours.
- The brand palette below (taken from the Squalor site palette) is not used. It is authoritative for this repository: the brand style guide lives outside this repo, and you do not need it. Colours may be used freely, and this slice uses no brand marks.

## Files

- `app/src/main/java/com/squalor/consecutor/ConsecutorTheme.kt`
- New `app/src/main/java/com/squalor/consecutor/Palette.kt` (plain Kotlin colour constants and a contrast function, so JVM tests can use them)
- `app/src/main/java/com/squalor/consecutor/MainActivity.kt`
- `app/src/main/res/values/themes.xml`, `values-night/themes.xml`, `values/colors.xml`
- New `app/src/test/java/com/squalor/consecutor/PaletteContrastTest.kt`

## Failing tests

JVM, in `PaletteContrastTest`, using `contrastRatio(foreground: Long, background: Long): Double` from `Palette.kt` (WCAG 2: relative luminance `L = 0.2126 R + 0.7152 G + 0.0722 B` with each channel `c` in 0..1 linearised as `c <= 0.03928 ? c / 12.92 : ((c + 0.055) / 1.055) ^ 2.4`, and ratio `(Llighter + 0.05) / (Ldarker + 0.05)`):
- `contrast of black on white is 21` (sanity check of the function)
- `dark palette text pairs meet 4.5 to 1`: onPrimary on primary, onSurface on surface, onBackground on background, onSurfaceVariant on surfaceVariant, tertiary on surface
- `light palette text pairs meet 4.5 to 1`: the same pairs
If a pair fails, adjust the foreground colour (or the container) until it passes, and record the changed hex values with `slicer note S11`.

## Implement

1. Dark scheme (from the site palette):
   - background `#0f1419`
   - surface `#18242d`, surfaceVariant/surfaceContainerHigh `#223542`
   - onBackground/onSurface `#f4efe7`, onSurfaceVariant `#b4c0c8`
   - primary `#6ee7d2` with onPrimary `#0f1419`
   - tertiary (gold, sparingly: streak/longest highlights only) `#f6c177`
2. Light scheme (from the paper palette):
   - background `#f7f4ef`, surface `#ffffff`, outline `#d4dde3`
   - onSurface `#18242d`, onSurfaceVariant `#5c6b75`
   - primary `#0f766e` with onPrimary `#ffffff`
   - tertiary `#b45309`
3. Select with `isSystemInDarkTheme()`. Check the contrast of primary/onPrimary and the text colors against WCAG AA (4.5:1) and adjust the containers if needed.
4. XML: parent `android:Theme.Material.NoActionBar` in values and values-night, with `android:windowBackground` set to the background color. Call `enableEdgeToEdge()` in MainActivity; activity 1.9 has it. Ensure Scaffold insets work.
5. Typography: keep `Typography()` defaults (system sans fits the brand's "system sans" guidance). Use uppercase with wide tracking only for the app-bar title "CONSECUTOR" on the dashboard.
6. Remove the template colors from colors.xml.
